interpretation: Checks declared metadata and supplied grouping IDs. It cannot validate license rights, establish homology clusters or detect unknown source overlap. Content hash covers canonical JSON rows, not original file bytes.
study_note: A deliberately unsafe deterministic row split applied to REAL data, to test that the checker rejects cross-split sequences and papers. It is not an actual upstream published training split. Missing MICs also fail the declared contract. Failure is expected and useful; no upstream defect is alleged.
